summary: Public site foundation: app/(public) route group with SiteShell (skip link, sticky header, desktop nav with aria-current, sign-in / panel link, mobile disclosure menu closing on Escape and navigation, footer), a real home page replacing the infrastructure status page (only Phase 1 services that exist today, no prices, times or statistics), an about page with breadcrumb, a Persian 404 with noindex, public error and loading states. SEO: buildMetadata gives absolute canonical without query/fragment, fa_IR OpenGraph and Twitter, ARCHIVED noindex+follow, DUPLICATE canonical to the primary + noindex, and nothing indexed outside production; the root layout defaults to noindex. JSON-LD Organization, WebSite and BreadcrumbList serialised safely against </script>. Segmented sitemap (/sitemap.xml index + /sitemaps/<section>.xml, no invented lastmod) and robots.txt derived from the route access map with anchored rules so /vet never hides /veterinarians. SITE_URL is required and https in production. Only built sections are linked; planned §4 sections stay closed routes. No schema or migration.
